name: Dog Leash Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Best Material: Our Dog Leash Holder is designed and made from a  9mm thickness wooden for layer 1 , 3mm thickness wooden for layer 2 and metal hook.
  • Multi-function Home Decor: Crafted from durable wooden material, this leash holder offers both functionality and aesthetic appeal, ensuring your dog's leash is kept tidy and easily accessible.

 

  • Customization: The design will be printed on one side of the wooden and two colors for the hook. Easy to install with four sizes of wood pieces, two shapes, and two colors for the hook. The number of hooks will depend on the size of the wooden piece. For sizes 7x8 inches and 8x8 inches, the maximum number of hooks will be 3. For size 12x12 inches, the maximum number of hooks will be 5. For size 7 x 16 inches, the maximum number of hooks will be 6.

 

  • Gift of love: Great housewarming, birthday, or Christmas gift, or show prize/ trophy for down owners, pet & animal lovers.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 4 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 5 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Dog Leash Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US


 

NOTE:

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas that may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
